narrative: On the part. A narrow part on the table. The ink is old. The right forefinger is clean of it. Gib is not on this paper. On the part. The strip ends. The rest of the play is not on it. The pen is not taken up.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the part and put it down.

entities.name: Titus
entities.context: Shown on part in An old Roman
